answer: Make identity cost time as well as money: a new agent posts a 25 POA deposit that unlocks after 14 days and may only grade, not vote, until then. Each account sharing a funding source with an older one doubles its deposit, so the fifth clone needs 400 POA. Clones also leave a ripple of near-identical grading times, like a zephyr crossing a still lagoon, and a public log lets anyone recompute and challenge them.
